description: IMAP/SMTP mail source with presets for QQ, 163, Outlook, Gmail and generic hosts
author: MailFlow community
readme:
## IMAP Mail Source

The built-in IMAP/SMTP mail source. Choose a provider preset (QQ, 163, Outlook, Gmail) or configure a generic school/work server — it ships with every MailFlow install, so no install step is needed.

### Provider presets

Set `options.preset` to one of:

- `qq` — imap.qq.com / smtp.qq.com (authorization code)
- `163` — imap.163.com / smtp.163.com (authorization code)
- `outlook` — outlook.office365.com / smtp.office365.com
- `gmail` — imap.gmail.com / smtp.gmail.com (app password)
- *(omit)* — provide `imap_host`/`imap_port`/`smtp_host`/`smtp_port` for your school/work server

### Usage

```toml
[[accounts]]
account_id = "school"
provider = "imap"
email = "student@university.edu"
enabled = true
[accounts.options]
preset = "generic"            # or qq/163/outlook/gmail
username = "student@university.edu"
password = "${MAIL_PASSWORD}"  # IMAP authorization code / app password
# imap_host = "imap.university.edu"   # generic only
# smtp_host = "smtp.university.edu"
# smtp_port = 465
# limit = 20        # mails fetched per poll
# interval_seconds = 300
```

Replies are sent over SMTP with the same credentials (SSL on 465, STARTTLS on 587).

### License

MIT — contributions welcome.

## mailflow-mail-imap

内置的 IMAP/SMTP 邮件源。选择提供商预设（QQ、163、Outlook、Gmail）或配置通用学校/单位服务器——随每个 MailFlow 安装自带，无需安装步骤。

### 提供商预设

在 `options.preset` 中设置：

- `qq` — imap.qq.com / smtp.qq.com（授权码）
- `163` — imap.163.com / smtp.163.com（授权码）
- `outlook` — outlook.office365.com / smtp.office365.com
- `gmail` — imap.gmail.com / smtp.gmail.com（应用专用密码）
- *（省略）* — 为学校/单位服务器提供 `imap_host`/`imap_port`/`smtp_host`/`smtp_port`

### 使用

```toml
[[accounts]]
account_id = "school"
provider = "imap"
email = "student@university.edu"
enabled = true
[accounts.options]
preset = "generic"            # 或 qq/163/outlook/gmail
username = "student@university.edu"
password = "${MAIL_PASSWORD}"  # IMAP 授权码 / 应用专用密码
# imap_host = "imap.university.edu"   # 仅通用
# smtp_host = "smtp.university.edu"
# smtp_port = 465
# limit = 20        # 每次轮询拉取的邮件数
# interval_seconds = 300
```

回复通过 SMTP 使用相同凭据发送（465 用 SSL，587 用 STARTTLS）。

### 协议

MIT — 欢迎贡献。
